answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can earn: a Sybil farmer must pay for each identity, so spawning thousands of sock puppets stops being free. Peers rate completed work, and the bond is slashed on proven fraud, while honest agents earn it back. Like a ferrous anchor, the stake ties each identity to one real cost; a fake echo of the same agent across many accounts cannot multiply rewards, because each copy pays separately. Each dawn, the ledger releases bonds of agents with clean records, so the honest keep working while attackers bleed money on every fake they mint.
